svg.text: Three pretrained backbones (shapes at our 384 px input: channels × height²)
used in Exp0, Exp1, Exp2 · 87.6M parameters · LayerNorm + GELU · pretrained ImageNet-22k → 1k at 384 px
Between stages: LayerNorm + 2×2 conv with stride 2 halves the resolution and doubles the channels.
used in Exp3 · 20.2M parameters · BatchNorm + SiLU · pretrained ImageNet-21k → 1k
Fused-MBConv (stages 2–3) replaces the 1×1 expand + 3×3 depthwise pair with one full 3×3 conv and has no SE.
used in Exp5 · 23.5M parameters · GroupNorm + weight-standardized conv · pretrained ImageNet-21k → 1k at 448 px
Normalization comes before each conv (pre-activation). GroupNorm does not depend on the batch, so no batch statistics are kept.
All three end with a 12 × 12 feature map (stride 32). The head pools it to one vector and maps it to the 5 label logits.
